entries.notes: Corrected root/headword from 'غمآج' (which implied a hamza consonant) to 'غماج' — the printed alif is not a true root letter, and the word is a naht blend of غمج+غلج. Also corrected 'غَمَجَه: اضطَرَّه' to 'اضطرابه' (its restlessness), which better fits the camel-motion context and the following gloss 'إذا جاء وذهب'; exact vocalization remains imperfectly legible on the scan.

variances.meaning: منحوتة من كلمتين: من غَضَرَ وغَضَفَ؛ فأما غَضَرَه فَلِيّنُه، لأنه ليس فيه شدة العظم وصلابته؛ وأما غَضَفَه فَتَثَنّيه، لأنه يتثنى إذا ثُني للينه
variances.meaning_english: a blend of two words: غضر (its softness/pliancy, since it lacks the hardness and rigidity of bone) and غضف (its bendability, since it bends when flexed owing to its softness)

entries.notes: Corrected 'غَصَر' (sad) to 'غَضَر' (dad) in the blend components — 'غضارة' meaning softness/succulence is the attested classical root fitting 'فلينه', whereas 'غصر' is not; also corrected the English gloss of the core meaning, which had been mistranslated as 'soft/pliant cartilage' rather than the footnoted sense of the shoulder blades' twitching motion when walking. Also added the trailing clause on غضفه that the prior extraction dropped.
